name: Grilled meat in steamed rice sheets
nameVi: Thịt xiên nướng cuốn bánh ướt
summary: Thịt xiên nướng cuốn bánh ướt is hot grilled meat rolled in a steamed rice sheet with Trà Quế herbs, green banana, and cucumber. The meat is fragrant, the sauce is sweet, the chili is hot, and the herbs are astringent.
origin: Da Nang. The herbs come from Trà Quế.
taste: A sweet sauce, fragrant meat, chili heat, and the astringent bite of the herbs.
howToEat: Roll the meat, still hot off the charcoal, in a steamed rice sheet with the herbs, green banana, and cucumber, then use the sauce.
where: Trà Quế, the herb village outside Hội An, grows the herbs. In Da Nang, ask for thịt xiên nướng cuốn bánh ướt by name.
seoTitle: Grilled meat in banh uot — a Da Nang plate
seoDescription: Da Nang rolls hot grilled meat in bánh ướt with Trà Quế herbs, green banana, and cucumber. The sauce is sweet, the meat fragrant, the chili hot, and the herbs astringent.
